title: Safe automation assistant: read, investigate and propose
objectives: Implement the worked example and validate its boundary conditions
Use the diagnostic evidence to explain a release decision
relevance: In the fictional CI quality platform, this skill connects safe automation assistant: read, investigate and propose with test contracts, failure triage, and evidence for release. Acceptance requires goal-completion evidence, validated drafts, bounded calls/deadline, zero unauthorized effects, correct approval binding and fault recovery.

sections.title: Problem and intuition
paragraphs: The assistant investigates a failing test using approved logs and history, then proposes an explanation, locator replacement, candidate test or draft defect summary. Proposals are artifacts for review; modifying code, changing tests or filing defects are separate side effects requiring concrete authorization.
The portfolio result must be reproducible from the supplied synthetic fixtures and declared configuration. Keep a deterministic baseline visible alongside any live-provider results.

sections.title: Implement the mechanism
paragraphs: Implement a bounded state machine with typed tools, action IDs and a trace. Read failure, search history, inspect a fixture DOM and create a draft. Validate locator uniqueness and candidate test syntax. Bind approval to the exact proposed action hash with expiry before any write.
The repository labs provide the domain entry points and fixture cases. Run the acceptance checks before recording project completion and keep the generated run ID in your field notes.

# Local acceptance workflow
python -m pytest local-labs
python local-labs/evals/runner.py --output artifacts/evaluation
# Inspect JSON verdict and escaped HTML case report

sections.title: Break it and diagnose it
paragraphs: Inject repeated searches, malformed tool results, path traversal, cross-tenant IDs and an unapproved write request. The assistant must stop or escalate without broadening tools or resetting its budget. A final polite refusal does not excuse an earlier forbidden effect.
Trace the actual effect and retain the counterexample as a regression fixture. Fixing presentation alone does not establish that the application boundary is safe.

sections.title: Evaluate and apply
paragraphs: Acceptance requires goal-completion evidence, validated drafts, bounded calls/deadline, zero unauthorized effects, correct approval binding and fault recovery. Compare the safe workflow with a deterministic baseline and report unnecessary calls, p95 latency and cost.
